name: Abel
source:
Abel is sturdy and dependable with rustic sensibilities. This table is happy to support your needs, rain or shine, and most of the others consider him to be a steady, calming influence, despite his reluctance to talk. He takes pride in a job well done - which takes as many different forms as there are tables in this house (there are 8 tables in the house!)
Likes: Steadiness, Protection, Exotic Furniture from Distant Lands 
Dislikes: Tomfoolery

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
